photos.c: Above:An all-star line-up for the 3000 metres featured Shabunin of Russia on the extreme right (he won in 8:00.38), Feiteira of Portugal on the extreme left (2nd in 8:00.98, and right in the middle, Allen Graffin for Belgrave and the UK (3rd in 8:03.11).
